The new home renovation is primarily in a modern minimalist style, with an overall color scheme based on off-white and light gray, accented with sophisticated metal frames and wood textures to create a clean and bright atmosphere. The living room features an ivory-white leather sofa, paired with a gray and white geometric-patterned rug. The coffee table has a marble top with a metal frame.  

In the dining area, a natural wood dining table and chairs are used, complemented by light gray seat cushions. The bedroom is furnished with soft off-white bedding, paired with light blue throw pillows and a small wool-textured rug. The study features a dark walnut desk, paired with an ergonomic chair.  

The walls are adorned with minimalist paintings, while the curtains combine sheer white voile with thick gray blackout fabric, adding warmth and a cozy ambiance. The living room has windows—one on the right-side wall and another in the center of the opposite wall, connecting to the balcony.
